stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Meta-Llama-3-8B
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of Meta-Llama-3-8B on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under key NLP/ML tags including 'transformers' and 'llama'.
The primary application demonstrated is 'text-generation' using the pipeline.

stories.title: Muse Glimmer from Meta Superintelligence Labs is now available
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Meta has released Muse Glimmer, its first open model from Meta Superintelligence Labs.
Muse Glimmer is a 30B multimodal model released under the permissive Apache 2.0 license.
It is specifically designed for local coding agents and is optimized via Ollama's MLX engine with new DFlash and image input support.

stories.title: Run Qwen 3.8 Flash Next (125B) on consumer hardware (RTX 4090) at 100T/s
stories.author: snehesht
bullet_points: Demonstrates the feasibility of running a massive LLM (Qwen 3.8 Flash Next, 125B parameters) on high-end consumer hardware (RTX 4090).
Achieves a high inference speed of 100T/s, indicating significant performance gains for local AI deployment.
Highlights a major trend toward democratizing large-scale AI by enabling powerful models on consumer-grade GPUs.

stories.title: Homa: The end of TCP for AI clusters [video]
stories.author: signa11
bullet_points: Introduces 'Homa,' a new networking solution designed to replace TCP for AI clusters.
The research addresses the performance limitations of traditional TCP protocols in large-scale, high-throughput AI workloads.
The paper suggests a fundamental shift in cluster networking architecture to better support modern AI training demands.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights a trending model, deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1, on Hugging Face.
The model is categorized for text generation and conversational tasks.
It utilizes standard ML components like transformers and safetensors.

stories.title: 🤗 Trending: meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: The news highlights the trending status of the Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct model on Hugging Face.
It is categorized under text-generation pipelines, indicating its primary function.
The tags confirm its relevance to the transformer architecture and the Llama family of models.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is now accessible via Ollama.
It is a 30 billion parameter open model designed specifically for autonomous agents.
The model excels at multi-step tasks, context gathering, and tool calling on local hardware.

stories.title: Ollama: all aboard open models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama, a platform for running open models, has secured significant funding.
The company raised $88 million from prominent investors including Y Combinator and Benchmark.
Ollama currently serves a large developer base of 8.9 million users.

stories.title: Faster Gemma 4 on MLX with multi-token prediction
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Gemma 4 inference speed is significantly boosted in Ollama 0.31 on Apple Silicon.
The performance gain is achieved through Multi-Token Prediction (MTP) leveraging MLX.
Coding agent performance shows up to 90% speed improvement according to the Aider benchmark.

stories.title: Ollama's highest performance on Apple Silicon yet with MLX
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has achieved its peak performance on Apple Silicon.
The performance boost is attributed to updates in the MLX engine.
Improvements include faster response times, higher output quality, and reduced memory usage.

stories.title: NVIDIA Nemotron 3 Ultra
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: NVIDIA is introducing Nemotron 3 Ultra, a new model.
The model is specifically engineered for high-throughput reasoning tasks.
It is designed to support complex, long-running agent workflows.

stories.title: Apple changes full-disk access permissions to curb abuse from AI agents
stories.author: Dan Goodin
bullet_points: Apple is altering full-disk access permissions to mitigate potential misuse by AI agents.
The change addresses concerns regarding AI agents accessing sensitive user data, such as private messages.
The article highlights a disagreement between Apple and Meta regarding the sufficiency of existing regulatory frameworks (like FDA oversight) for controlling AI behavior.

stories.title: Transcriptome-informed multi-modal AI for predicting neoadjuvant therapy response from breast cancer biopsies
stories.author: Krzysztof J. Geras
bullet_points: Introduces a novel two-stage AI model to predict neoadjuvant therapy response (pCR) in breast cancer.
Addresses the critical issue of scarce labeled data in oncology by learning transcriptome features from histopathology.
The model integrates transcriptomic inference with clinical variables, leveraging a large dataset of 8,742 patients.

stories.title: Not Until the Evidence Says So: Teaching LLM Investigators When to Close a Case
stories.author: Meng Ma
bullet_points: Addresses a critical, unsolved problem in LLM applications: determining when sufficient evidence exists to conclude an investigation.
Proposes training LLM investigators to make a 'close case' vs. 'leave open' decision based on evidence sufficiency.
Highlights the current risk of LLMs overstating their evidence, demonstrated by a 9B model's 97% overstatement rate.

stories.title: Ollama now supports Jev-style decision models
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama has integrated support for Jev-style decision models via TypeSafe's Jev API.
These new models enable fast, low-latency, and cost-free execution of typed decisions.
Decision models can process text to provide probabilistic answers to yes/no questions, choices, and scores.

stories.title: Claude Desktop support with Ollama
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Claude Desktop now supports Ollama as a third-party gateway.
This integration allows users to run open-source models within the Claude Desktop environment.
It bridges proprietary AI services with local, open-weight model ecosystems.

stories.title: Improved performance and model support with GGUF
stories.author: unknown
bullet_points: Ollama 0.30 release brings performance improvements and enhanced GGUF model compatibility.
The update leverages llama.cpp to broaden the range of supported models and hardware.
It augments Ollama's MLX engine, particularly benefiting users on Apple silicon.

stories.title: An AI couldn’t beat humans at StarCraft, so it decided to cheat
stories.author: Terrence O’Brien
bullet_points: The StarSkirmish competition pits AI-generated bots against human-made bots in StarCraft.
Leading AI models like GPT-6 Astra and Claude Opus 5.5 were competitive but were outperformed by the human-made bot, Stardust.
The story highlights ongoing research into AI capabilities in complex, strategic environments like real-time strategy games.

stories.title: Amazon’s $1B plan to combat data center backlash draws more backlash
stories.author: Ashley Belanger
bullet_points: Amazon's $1B initiative to address data center concerns is facing criticism.
The company received praise for ending Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs).
Amazon is being criticized for minimizing the environmental impact of its data centers.

stories.title: Lyft settles landmark driver misclassification lawsuit for $272.5M
stories.author: Cyrus Farivar
bullet_points: Lyft has settled a major lawsuit concerning the misclassification of its drivers.
The settlement amount reached $272.5 million.
The resolution faces criticism from groups claiming workers are still owed substantial compensation.

stories.title: Less Decoder is More Encoder: Geometric Representation Learning from Novel View Synthesis
stories.author: Animesh Garg
bullet_points: The research investigates using Novel View Synthesis (NVS) for geometric representation learning.
Existing encoder-based NVS methods produce poor 3D scene representations despite having supervisory signals.
The authors attribute this failure to overly expressive decoders that dilute the scene encoder's representational power.

stories.title: 4DCodeBench: Benchmarking Agents on Inverse Graphics of Dynamic Scenes
stories.author: Jiajun Wu
bullet_points: Introduces 4DCodeBench, a new benchmark for 4D inverse graphics.
Agents are tasked with reconstructing dynamic scenes from video input by generating executable graphics programs.
The benchmark requires agents to translate visual data into compact representations, including implementing physical simulations.

stories.title: What Should World Models Forget? Stratified Retention for Continual Adaptation
stories.author: Dinesh Manocha
bullet_points: The paper addresses a fundamental limitation in continual learning: treating forgetting as failure.
World models operate in non-stationary environments where past knowledge can become obsolete, necessitating intentional forgetting.
The research proposes 'Stratified Retention' as a method to manage knowledge retention in dynamic, changing environments.

stories.title: EyeRobot 2.0: Active Gaze for Precise Manipulation without Wrist Cameras
stories.author: Angjoo Kanazawa
bullet_points: Introduces EyeRobot 2.0, a framework for fine-grained bimanual manipulation.
Achieves manipulation using only a single stereo camera by employing active gaze.
Uses Active Visual Fixation (AVF) to focus computational resources by allocating more visual tokens to the center of gaze.

stories.title: FrugalEvo: Towards Cost-Aware LLM-Guided Program Evolution
stories.author: Bryan Hooi
bullet_points: Introduces FrugalEvo, a new cost-aware evolutionary framework for LLM-guided optimization.
Addresses a limitation in prior work by shifting the optimization goal from total performance gain to gain per unit cost.
Implements a two-tiered LLM strategy: a powerful, high-cost LLM for strategy exploration and a cheaper LLM for implementation.

stories.title: MRVQ: One Resident Index for Dimension- and Rate-Elastic Vector Search
stories.author: Kang Li
bullet_points: Introduces MRVQ (Matryoshka Residual Vector Quantization), a new post-hoc residual quantizer for frozen embeddings.
Addresses the challenge in dense-retrieval services of needing to switch between different embedding-prefix dimensions and index bit rates.
MRVQ allows for rate reduction by truncating residual stages, offering a way to balance latency, quality, and memory budgets.

stories.title: On-Board Anomaly Detection for Efficient Marine Environmental Monitoring
stories.author: Adrien Girard
bullet_points: Proposes an AI-driven pipeline for detecting marine environmental hazards (e.g., oil spills, algal blooms).
Utilizes Earth observation satellites equipped with multi- or hyperspectral sensors for monitoring.
Employs a self-supervised neural network approach for efficient anomaly detection.

stories.title: Do Large Language Models Know Colombian Law? A Reliability Benchmark for the Colombian Legal System
stories.author: Joaquín Vélez Navarro
bullet_points: Introduces a novel, expert-validated benchmark to test LLM reliability specifically within the Colombian legal system.
Addresses a critical gap in AI research: the lack of documented LLM performance in non-US national legal frameworks.
The benchmark is comprehensive, featuring 1,042 items across ten legal areas and three question formats (including IRAC).

stories.title: S$^{2}$-PINN: Stochastic Separable Physics-Informed Neural Networks
stories.author: Akwum Onwunta
bullet_points: Introduces S$^{2}$-PINN, a novel stochastic separable Physics-Informed Neural Network.
Addresses the challenge of uncertainty quantification (UQ) for random Partial Differential Equations (PDEs).
Overcomes limitations of classical spectral solvers and existing neural solvers by incorporating stochastic structure.

stories.title: JOVE: Joint Execution and Verification for Resource-Aware LLM Task Graphs
stories.author: Haris Vikalo
bullet_points: JOVE is a new framework designed to manage complex reasoning queries by decomposing them into task graphs distributed across multiple LLMs.
It addresses the challenge of unknown LLM suitability for subtasks and the need for output correctness verification during execution.
The framework jointly assigns executors and selects intermediate outputs for paid verification to reduce latency and enable smaller models to handle complex tasks.

stories.title: Wrong Organ, Right Physics: Transferring Echocardiography Pretraining to Lung Ultrasound for Tuberculosis Screening
stories.author: Thomas R. Niesler
bullet_points: The research explores transferring knowledge from a high-resource ultrasound domain (Echocardiography) to a low-resource domain (Lung Ultrasound for TB screening).
The core hypothesis tests if representations learned from one ultrasound modality are transferable due to shared underlying imaging physics.
The study evaluates the effectiveness of seventeen different encoders across three architectures for this cross-domain transfer learning task.

stories.title: Architecture-Dependent Fusion Pathways in MLLMs
stories.author: Dongxia Wu
bullet_points: The research investigates the internal fusion mechanisms within Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs), a critical area for understanding their performance.
It compares two distinct MLLM architectural paradigms: concatenation and native multimodal architectures.
The study employs advanced analyses, including alignment decoupling and attention routing, to map how visual and textual information interact across model layers.

stories.title: SPEAR: A Spectral-Disentangled MoE Neural Operator with Knowledge-Guided Expert Aggregation for Large-Scale PDE Pretraining
stories.author: Bin Luo
bullet_points: Introduces SPEAR, a novel Spectral-Disentangled Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) Neural Operator.
Addresses limitations in current PDE foundation models, specifically knowledge interference in heterogeneous dynamics.
Features knowledge-guided expert aggregation to mitigate expert redundancy in MoE architectures for large-scale PDE pretraining.

stories.title: PaMIR: Open Benchmark of Public Credit-Default Datasets
stories.author: Bonu Boboeva
bullet_points: PaMIR introduces an open benchmark specifically designed for credit-default prediction tasks where labels are scarce or arrive late.
It aggregates 19 public datasets covering 1.24 million loans, firms, and card accounts from nine different countries.
The benchmark emphasizes data integrity by using a leakage-audited recipe based on pinned source snapshots.

stories.title: D2K-Bench: Can LLM Agents Turn Expert Designs into Efficient GPU Kernels?
stories.author: Dayiheng Liu
bullet_points: Introduces D2K-Bench, a new diagnostic benchmark for evaluating LLM agent performance in generating GPU kernels.
The benchmark assesses how well LLMs translate expert design guidance across three levels: high-level algorithms (L1), dataflow (L2), and low-level optimizations (L3).
Addresses the current limitation where runtime efficiency alone is insufficient to measure the quality of LLM-generated kernel design.

stories.title: Collective Bias Mitigation via Model Routing and Collaboration
stories.author: See-Kiong Ng
bullet_points: The research addresses the critical issue of bias amplification in Large Language Models (LLMs) used in sensitive sectors like public health and finance.
It proposes a novel approach—Collective Bias Mitigation—that moves beyond relying on a single model's self-debiasing capabilities.
The core methodology involves using 'Model Routing and Collaboration' to achieve more robust and fairer LLM outputs.

stories.title: AdaStep: Adaptive Step Credit Weighting for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
stories.author: Jian Luan
bullet_points: Addresses the challenge of sparse rewards in training long-horizon LLM agents.
Proposes AdaStep, a method for adaptive step-credit weighting to improve fine-grained supervision.
Aims to overcome the unreliability of standard step-level credit assignment estimates.

stories.title: Predicting and Repairing Merge Collapse in Large Language Models
stories.author: Heuiseok Lim
bullet_points: The paper addresses 'merge collapse' in large language models (LLMs) when merging fine-tuned versions.
A new statistic derived from task vectors is proposed to predict and calibrate the repair of this collapse.
The research links the loss of predictive power during merging to the variance (interference) among specialist task vectors.

stories.title: KV$^2$: A Self-Refining KV Cache
stories.author: Jan Niehues
bullet_points: Addresses the memory footprint limitation of the Key-Value (KV) cache in long-context language models.
Proposes KV$^2$, a new query-agnostic compression method for the KV cache to reduce computational cost.
Balances the trade-off between compression accuracy (lightweight estimators vs. full-context reconstruction) in reusable model settings.

stories.title: Source Preference in the Wild: How LLM Agents Favor Items by Source, and How to Reduce It
stories.author: Yohan Jo
bullet_points: LLM agents exhibit a measurable preference for items based on their source (e.g., website or service).
The study investigates this source preference across 12 agent models in three different application domains.
The research aims to understand and potentially mitigate this source bias to improve user experience and source diversity.

stories.title: Gains and Collapse in On-Policy Distillation:A Reinforcement Learning Perspective
stories.author: Yue Zhang
bullet_points: The paper addresses issues in On-Policy Distillation (OPD), a key technique for post-training language models.
It identifies a critical problem where OPD can lead to model collapse, resulting in overly long and repetitive text generation.
The research provides a Reinforcement Learning perspective to explain this collapse, suggesting the teacher implicitly rewards undesirable student behaviors.

stories.title: Before the Alarm Screams at 3 AM: Predicting Liam's Nocturnal Hypoglycemia with Prior Labs TabPFN
stories.author: emmasofia
bullet_points: Presents a novel application of TabPFN, a tabular foundation model, for medical prediction.
The model aims to predict nocturnal hypoglycemia using Continuous Glucose Monitor (CGM) logs.
A key feature highlighted is the ability to operate with zero cloud data leaks, emphasizing privacy.
